response.overview: Harvey Elder a young orphan who goes to a private school in New York gets body shamed and ridiculed for his obsessive interest in finding a mysterious cavern known as Subterranea. With a goal to become Subterranea's "ruler". When he finds out his school teacher Mr Ludgate is actually an undercover soccerer named Dr Druid US military to locate the cavern in his home city, Harvey is driven to find it before Dr Druid and the US military. As he slowly descends to madness and eventually commiting a mass genocide in his own school he becomes the ruthless tyrant of Subterranea known to the surface world as The Mole Man.
response.title: MOLE MAN
